Settings run: 10x left from 8 -> 0 and stays 0; 13x right -> 10 and stays 10; Language right en->es->fr, left fr->es; Difficulty default normal, left -> easy (stays), right -> normal -> hard (stays).

es: title [Mejor, Empezar, Continuar, Ajustes, Salir], settings [Ajustes, Volumen, Idioma: Español, Dificultad: Fácil, Volver], play [Puntos, Monedas, Oleada 8 de 8, Puerta], paused [En pausa, Reanudar, Título], shop [Tienda, Monedas, Siguiente: oleada 8, Manos rápidas, Virotes pesados, Albañil, Siguiente oleada], won [Has ganado...], lost [Has perdido...]; fr likewise on all seven screens (Réglages, Vague 8 sur 8, Boutique, Mains vives, Maçon, Gagné, Perdu, Entrée : titre). Only the name stays English.
Run 1 set volume 10, fr, easy in judge-scratch/c; run 2 with same folder starts title with language fr, volume 10, difficulty easy; a fresh folder starts en, 8, normal.
Hold up from y=6: 7.0 after 10 ticks (0.1/tick = 6 u/s), 12 at tick 62 and stays 12; hold down: reaches 0 at tick 270 and stays 0.
Holding shoot from tick 42: bolts appear at ticks 43 and 67 (24 apart); x advances 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); a bolt at x 19.97 at tick 86 is gone at tick 87.
Seed 1, no shooting: walkers appear at x=20 at ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (90 ticks apart), lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s); 5 in all, then shop.
Walker in lane 2 at health 1 after first bolt (tick 121); second hit removes it, score 10 coins 1 (tick 200). Bolts in lane 6 flew past a lane-4 walker at x 2.95 which kept health 2.
Walkers reaching x<=0 removed, gate 10 -> 8 -> 6 -> 5, score/coins stay 0. Gate 1 at wave 8 (fr) and gate 5 at wave 2 (en): screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Best: 1,590, Enter: title].
Difficulty easy: Start gives gate_health 14 ('Porte : 14'). Difficulty hard (judge-scratch/h): Start gives gate_health 7 ('Gate: 7').

After wave 1's last walker: screen shop, texts [Shop, Coins: 5, Next: wave 2, Quick hands 0/2 - 5 coins, Heavy bolts 0/1 - 12 coins, Mason - 4 coins, Next wave]; state identical from tick 1170 to 1300 (nothing moves); Escape in the shop changed nothing.
Saved run with 100 coins: Quick hands -> coins 95 quick 1, -> 85 quick 2, third Enter -> 85 quick 2. Held shoot: bolt spacing 4.2 units (18 ticks) at quick 1, 2.8 units (12 ticks) at quick 2.
Heavy bolts 85 -> 73 heavy 1, second Enter stays 73. Tick 167->168: one bolt hits a fresh lane-4 walker (health 2) and it is destroyed, score +10 coin +1.
Run difficulty hard, gate 5, coins 20: Mason -> gate 7 coins 16 (capped at 7, not 8), further Enter no change. Normal gate 10 coins 73: Mason no change. Gate 3 coins 3: Mason no change.
Next wave entered at tick 7 (play from tick 8); first wave-2 walker at x=20 at tick 68 (60 ticks later); texts 'Wave 2 of 8'; wave 2 had 7 walkers (seen across the wave in the shop->wave 2 runs).

Wave 3 (continued from saved wave 2): 6 walkers at 72-tick gaps (ticks 67..427), then runners at 499, 571, 643, 715; runner health 1, x drops 0.05/tick (3 u/s); gate 100 -> 90 (10 enemies). Shooting lane 10: three runners killed, score 45 coins 3 (15 and 1 each).
Wave 4: 8 walkers then a brute at tick 643, health 6, x drops 1/60 per tick; gate 92 -> 89 when it got through (3). Shooting its lane: brute killed, score 10 -> 50, coins 1 -> 4.

modules/work/waves.csv holds the 8 waves as rows 'walkers runners brutes seconds', read by waves() via include_str; README 'Change a wave' explains it. Judged by reading; I did not edit the file (no repairs allowed).

Saved run at wave 7 (gate 100, quick 2, heavy 1) played wave 8 holding shoot: won with score 1590 = 70 kill points + 20 x 76 gate left; saved false; Enter on won -> title at tick 2351. (Gate 100 crafted in the kept file to survive wave 8.)
Escape at tick 100: paused, enemies frozen to tick 150; Resume (Escape, and Enter on Resume in es run) continues from x 17.55 -> 17.525; Title (down, Enter) -> title screen at tick 53.
Shop opening set saved true and wrote kept.save; next run with the same folder: texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
Run bought Quick hands (coins 5 -> 0) then left; next run Continue -> shop with Coins 0, Quick hands 1/2, Next: wave 2, gate 10, score 50; Next wave plays 'Wave 2 of 8', Score 50.

Title from pause: title shows Continue, kept.save still the wave-1 shop (b3 file after run). Start then -> saved false, Title from pause shows no Continue, kept.save 0. Won and lost runs set saved false and kept.save 0.
Won 1590 -> won/title show Best: 1,590; next run's title shows Best: 1,590; a later lost run with 0 kept best 1590; won and lost screens show Best.
Two copies of the same kept folder, seed 5, same script, 700 ticks with --at: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 7 lanes 10,6,2,2,4 vs seed 1 lanes 2,4,8,6,6.

play.png at tick 1000 of wave 8: gray gate at left, blue guard at (2,6), yellow bolts on lane 6 at the x's printed, green squares (walkers), orange spheres (runners), large purple block (brute at x 19.65, lane 4), all at 40 px/unit matching state; HUD 'Score: 70 Coins: 6 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 95'.
title.png (Spanish, Ajustes outlined), settings.png (French, 'Langue : Français' outlined), shop.png (English, Mason outlined) all show menu with the chosen entry marked.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json hold all strings; UI files reference @keys; README 'Add a language' explains copying en.json. Judged by reading (adding a file would modify the game).

README has How to play, Where everything is kept (--settings FOLDER settings.json: settings, kept.best, kept.save), and the two commands; both ran as written (with my scratch folder in place of C:/some/folder).

defects: Shop entries at their last level read 'Quick hands 2/2 - - coins' / 'Heavy bolts 1/1 - - coins' (a dash where the price was), awkward in all three languages.
While the shop is open the play HUD stays drawn behind it in the frame (shows 'Wave 1 of 8' next to 'Next: wave 2'); settings frame shows the title's name partly behind the panel.
On the title the Start button is always drawn blue (primary style), so with focus on another entry two buttons look highlighted; the focused one is only outlined.
Up on the shop menu's first entry does nothing (no wrap); not wrong, but Down x3 is the only way to Next wave.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
